question: Where were the 2025 World Athletics Indoor Championships held?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Nanjing, China**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **2025 World Athletics Indoor Championships** are scheduled to be held in **Nanjing**, **China**. This marks a significant milestone as it is the first time the prestigious event will be hosted in **China**.
 
• The championships will take place at the **Nanjing's Cube**, a purpose-built facility located in the **Gymnasium of the Youth Olympic Sports Park**. The venue was specifically designed to host world-class indoor track and field events.
 
• The **Nanjing** edition has a long history of rescheduling; it was originally awarded as the **2020** championships but was postponed to **2021**, then **2023**, and finally **2025** due to the ongoing challenges posed by the **COVID-19 pandemic**.
 
• The event is scheduled to take place from **March 21 to March 23, 2025**. It will feature the world's top athletes competing in various indoor disciplines, including sprints, hurdles, jumps, and throws.
 
• **World Athletics** made the decision to postpone the event multiple times to ensure the safety of athletes and technical officials while maintaining the integrity of the competition cycle. ***Hence, the correct answer is Nanjing, China.***

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **World Athletics Indoor Championships:**
 
 
• It is a **biennial** (held every two years) athletics competition that began in **1985** as the World Indoor Games in **Paris**, **France**. It was later renamed in **1987**.
 
• The **2024** edition was successfully held in **Glasgow**, **United Kingdom**, while the **2026** edition is set to be hosted in **Torun**, **Poland**.
 
 
 
• **Host City Nanjing:**
 
 
• **Nanjing** is the capital of **Jiangsu province** in **China** and has a rich history of hosting international multi-sport events, most notably the **2014 Summer Youth Olympic Games**.
 
• The city's sports infrastructure is considered among the most advanced in **Asia**, making it a preferred location for **World Athletics** events.
 
 
 
• **Competition Categories:**
 
 
• The indoor championships differ from outdoor ones as they are held on a **200-meter track** (compared to 400m outdoors) and do not feature certain events like the javelin, discus, or hammer throw due to space constraints.
 
• Key events include the **60m sprint**, **60m hurdles**, **4x400m relay**, **Pole Vault**, **Triple Jump**, and **Shot Put**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Governing Body:** The event is organized by **World Athletics**, formerly known as the **IAAF** (International Association of Athletics Federations). The current President is **Sebastian Coe**, who took office in **2015**.
 
• **Qualification Standards:** Athletes must meet strict **entry standards** or qualify through their **World Ranking** to participate in the championships, ensuring only the elite tier of competitors is present.
 
• **Economic Impact:** Hosting the championships is expected to boost **Nanjing's** tourism and global profile, following the successful model of previous hosts like **Portland (2016)**, **Birmingham (2018)**, and **Belgrade (2022)**.
 
• **Sustainability:** For the **2025** event, organizers have emphasized **environmental sustainability** and **carbon neutrality** in the operation of the **Nanjing's Cube** facility.
